title: pentaraphia humilis
intro: Pentaraphia humilis, commonly known as the Chinese or Indian pentaraphia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Guttiferae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial activities, which can help in relieving fever, reducing inflammation, and treating various infections. The therapeutic actions of Pentaraphia humilis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-arthritic properties, and show potential in treating certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
